title: 3 Simple Dance Moves for Beginners (Hip Hop Dance Moves Tutorial) | Mihran Kirakosian

method.teacher_system: The teacher introduces three basic hip-hop dance moves step-by-step, breaking down footwork and posture. He demonstrates counts and repetitions before combining the moves into a short routine.
method.signature: Reminding learners to keep their knees bent and stay on their toes throughout the steps.

practices.what: Teacher demonstrates step-touch counting from 1 to 8, moving side to side.
Teacher introduces the second move staying in place with leg extending out and in.
Teacher connects move one and move two together and repeats counts.
Teacher introduces the third move involving a slide with the right leg stepping out.
Teacher runs through all three steps together in sequence multiple times.

adaptations.difficulty: arms don't know what to do
adaptations.adjustment: clap to keep the beat until comfortable
choose whatever arms you want, like pushing or clapping

beliefs.belief: dancing is all about your attitude, bending your knees, and giving it flavor
repeating steps over and over is key until you get comfortable
